verdict.rationale: Devin docs explicitly describe tagging Devin in Slack/Teams threads to discuss a bug with coworkers and delegating it, plus a /handoff flow for sending tasks from a lighter interaction to full cloud Devin sessions. This directly matches the story of tagging an agent in a chat thread to discuss/delegate a task. Missing for 10: independent hands-on confirmation of the chat-tagging workflow and more detail on multi-turn discussion before delegation.
